name: Hello World
author: Project Σ
description: The tour of every door, each shown once and small. The page: a command of its own and a wrapper on one of the app's, a verb in every menu, a button above the composer that writes into it, a chip on grid cards, a details tab, a view, a window in the conversation, a dialog, the conversation's hooks behind a setting that starts off, events, per-user storage and settings. The server: a table of waves (its report and its query doors), a store guard, a lore book and a prompt block behind settings that start off, a {{hello}} macro with arguments, a model call and a stream, a job, a schedule and a staged import. Ships off; enable it to try the api.
